name: Judicator Prime Field Court
role: Official deployed Union trial court aboard the G.U.S. Judicator Prime.
jurisdiction: Full trial-level authority over cases properly within Union jurisdiction and assigned to the Judicator Prime Field Court.

presiding_office.title: Field Judge
presiding_office.roster_status: OPEN — identity requires owner-authorized narrative admission
presiding_office.authority: Full authority to try cases, issue binding rulings and orders, and impose lawful trial-level remedies and sentences within jurisdiction.
presiding_office.seniority_equivalence: Comparable in institutional seniority and trial-level authority to a United States federal district court judge; equivalence does not import U.S. law into GUMAS.
presiding_office.command_independence: Not subordinate to Captain Alric Tann, Union Marshal command, Sentinel High Command, or the Judicator task-force chain when exercising judicial authority.

appeal_path: High Judiciary & Galactic Tribunal or another lawfully designated superior Union court
captain_boundary: Captain Tann governs vessel safety, movement, access, security, and emergency interruption; he does not direct findings, rulings, sentences, or case outcomes.
marshal_boundary: Marshals may investigate, arrest, preserve evidence, seek warrants, and present cases but do not control the court and remain subject to its orders.
notes: Court existence, Field Judge authority, trial-level independence, and district-judge seniority equivalence are owner-locked CANON. Exact judge identity, staffing, facility dimensions, and detailed procedural code remain open or STAGING.
